docs.title: Welcome to my recipe repo
docs.text: You are free to copy these recipes. They are a mix of recipes I have collected from my mother's old recipe books, my experiments and changes I have made to various recipes I have found from a variety of sources. For now, there are only a couple of recipes here, but I will be adding more as I get a chance.

docs.title: Focaccia
docs.text: This recipe can be warm or cold fermented depending on time constraints. The quantities suit a baking dish of about a X b cm.

docs.title: Ingredients
docs.text:
• 500g bread flour (I use Lauche Wallaby flour as it has the highest protein level of any of the flour varieties available from the supermarket)
  • 375g water (this is on the high side - you could safely reduce this to about 330g)
